items.stem: Which statement best describes a strategy rather than a goal?

options.text: How the firm will win: the distinctive choices it makes to create advantage
options.rationale: Correct: strategy is the integrated set of choices about how to compete and win.

options.text: A target to grow revenue by 20% next year
options.rationale: That is a goal, not how the firm will achieve it.

options.text: A list of this quarter's tasks

options.rationale: A mission states purpose, not the competitive approach.

items.explanation: Correct: strategy is the integrated set of choices about how to compete and win.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Using VRIO, which TWO conditions must a resource meet to be a source of sustained competitive advantage? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It is valuable to customers or cost position
options.rationale: Correct: value is the first VRIO test.

options.text: It is rare and hard for rivals to imitate
options.rationale: Correct: rarity and inimitability sustain the advantage.

options.text: It is listed on the balance sheet
options.rationale: Accounting recognition is not a VRIO criterion.

options.text: It is the cheapest resource available
options.rationale: Low cost alone does not confer advantage.

items.explanation: Correct: value, rarity and inimitability underpin sustained advantage.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A company pursues both the lowest price and the most premium differentiation at once and loses money. This is best described as:

options.text: Being 'stuck in the middle' without a clear competitive position
options.rationale: Correct: failing to commit to a generic strategy erodes advantage.
This is a failure of positioning, not a new uncontested market.
Cost leadership requires a disciplined low-cost focus.
Focus targets a niche, not everything at once.

items.explanation: Correct: failing to commit to a generic strategy erodes advantage.
